entities.summary: Pre-colonial (c. 1450 - 1683) african state located in what is now south-western zimbabwe, governed by the torwa dynasty until 1683 from its capital at khami, whose people were ancestors of the bakalanga Located in Zimbabwe. Founded 1450.
